name: G. H. Spear
role: Spearfish man running stages to Deadwood
bio: G. H. Spear of Spearfish set out for Deadwood in May 1884. In July 1884 the editor rode to Deadwood in one of Mr. Spear's stages, and the paper cited Spear as praising the Medora freight route.

moments.label: Editor rode to Deadwood in his stage

mentions: Western Starr, of Dickinson, and G. H. Spear, of Spearfish, started for Deadwood last Monday morning. They intend to take matters easy and to hunt and have a good time on the way down.
